content.short: Yale Blockchain Club fosters a vibrant ecosystem of Yale students and alumni interested in blockchain.
content.description: The Yale Blockchain Club, which now has 500+ members, is devoted to building the next generation of Web3 products. It educates Yale University students about blockchain technology and actively fosters collaboration among students, faculty, and industry leaders. Through its diverse resources, Yale students can learn essential concepts, engage with peers and mentors, participate in club activities, and contribute to the ongoing growth of blockchain technology within Yale’s community.
